title: Security Deck: Round 2
subtitle: Each card is a decision for you. Tap Yes, Maybe or No, add a private note if you like, and press Submit any time. Unanswered cards come back next round.

items.title: Change Niko's Home Guide Password
items.problem: The Home Guide password sat in plain text in test scripts on the shared computer. It is scrubbed now, but treat it as exposed.
items.fix: Construction changes it and tells Niko the new one. This touches a live client app, so it happens only with your OK.

items.title: Change The smartupkeep.ai Gate Passwords
items.problem: All nine smartupkeep.ai gate passwords sat in plain text in the password index. Scrubbed now, still exposed.
items.fix: UpKeep sets new ones (or moves to the real login you already approved) and shares them privately.

items.title: Change The Shared Page And Portfolio Passwords
items.problem: The shared locked-pages password and the Portfolio password were exposed, and the Portfolio one is reused on the smartupkeep.ai gate.
items.fix: Grok Bot and Portfolio set two new, different passwords, kept only in environment variables.

items.title: Change The Mellow Wood Lockbox Code
items.problem: The rental lockbox code sat in plain text in an agent's memory file. Scrubbed now.
items.fix: Change the code at the next visit and keep it only in your password manager.

items.title: Encrypted Vault For Tenant And Contract Files
items.problem: Tenant details and Niko contracts sit unencrypted on the shared computer. Access is now limited, but any agent can still read them.
items.fix: Move them into an encrypted vault (1Password documents or an encrypted Dropbox folder) that agents open only when needed.

items.title: Monthly Secret Leak Check On GitHub
items.problem: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are on for all 50 public repos, with 0 alerts today. Nobody reviews new alerts yet.
items.fix: Security checks alerts every month and fixes any leak the same day.

items.title: Spot Fake Invoices And Phishing
items.problem: Contractors, tenants and banks email you about money. A fake invoice or login page is the most common way small businesses lose money.
items.fix: A one-page guide: call back on a known number before paying any new bank details, and never log in from an email link.

items.title: Carrier PIN Against SIM Swaps
items.problem: If someone moves your phone number to their SIM, they get your bank text codes.
items.fix: Add a port-out PIN with your carrier and switch banks from text codes to app or passkey sign-in.
items.owner: Max, With A Guide From Security

items.title: Lock The smartupkeep.ai Domain
items.problem: If someone takes over the domain, they control the site and its email.
items.fix: Turn on registrar lock and 2FA at the registrar, and set auto-renew.

items.title: Check Recovery Emails And Phones
items.problem: Old recovery emails or numbers on Google, Apple, GitHub and banks are a back door into your accounts.
items.fix: Security sends a list; you confirm or update the recovery email and phone on each.
items.owner: Max, With A Checklist From Security

items.title: Lock Down Your Phone And Mac
items.problem: Your phone and Mac hold every login. A lost device without encryption exposes everything.
items.fix: Turn on FileVault, auto-lock within 5 minutes, Find My, and automatic updates on both.
items.owner: Max, With A Checklist From Security

items.title: Safe Wi-Fi While Traveling In Thailand
items.problem: Hotel and cafe Wi-Fi can be watched or faked, and you log into banks while traveling.
items.fix: Use your phone hotspot or a trusted VPN for banking, and turn off auto-join for open networks.
items.owner: Max, With A Guide From Security

items.title: Lock Down Dropbox
items.problem: Carried over: you said Maybe while an upload was finishing. A public edit link and an open upload request still exist, and tax and financial files sit in a shared folder.
items.fix: Remove the public edit link, close the upload request, and move the tax and financial files to a private folder once your upload is done.
